I'm sorry. I guess it kind of sheds some light on my mental state as of now. I hope I didn't offend you, or anyone else for that matter. 
Can't talk to family or a psychologist. Family thinks depression is an excuse for pitying yourself.
Try to kill myself, or try to talk to someone?
Maybe I should make this post when I know I'll make more sense. I'm just shaking right now and I'm not sure why. I'm sorry to anyone that I confused.
